content.value_statement: Log files hide service failures, error spikes, and slow requests. This skill turns raw logs into structured findings, timelines, and practical remediation guidance.
actual_capabilities: Identifies common log formats, including JSON, Apache access logs, and application logs.
Extracts timestamps, severity levels, services, endpoints, user identifiers, and stack trace context.
Summarizes top errors, frequency, time windows, and affected components.
Correlates events into incident timelines with likely contributing factors.
Suggests logging improvements, monitoring alerts, and remediation actions.
limitations: Does not access external log platforms without exported data or connected tool access.
Cannot confirm root cause without service context, metrics, traces, or deployment history.
Large log sets may require sampling, filtering, or chunking before analysis.
May expose sensitive fields unless logs are redacted before review.

use_cases.title: Triage Production Incidents
use_cases.description: Find error spikes, impacted services, and likely causes during an active outage.

use_cases.title: Improve Application Reliability
use_cases.description: Review recurring errors, slow endpoints, and monitoring gaps after a release.

use_cases.title: Summarize Operational Health
use_cases.description: Convert routine log exports into status summaries and action lists for stakeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Log Summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small log excerpt.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this log excerpt. Identify the format, count errors and warnings, and list the top three issues with simple explanations.

prompt_templates.title: Error Trend Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate analysis of a defined time window.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review app.log for the last 24 hours. Summarize error trends, affected services, peak times, and likely causes.

prompt_templates.title: Incident Timeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced correlation across multiple log sources.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these web and application logs. Correlate request IDs, authentication failures, latency spikes, and database errors into one incident timeline.

prompt_templates.title: Production Incident Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced report for incident response and follow-up work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a production incident report from these logs. Include severity, evidence, root cause hypotheses, immediate actions, and monitoring gaps.

output_examples.input: A 24-hour API log export with database errors and slow request entries.
output_examples.output: A report showing peak error windows, top failing services, likely connection pressure, and immediate monitoring actions.

output_examples.input: Access logs with repeated rate limit responses from several client addresses.
output_examples.output: A summary separating likely automated traffic from legitimate bursts, with review steps before blocking users.

output_examples.input: Application logs from a release window with warnings, stack traces, and latency changes.
output_examples.output: A timeline that links the release, new errors, slower endpoints, and follow-up checks for developers.

best_practices: Provide a clear time window and note deployments or incidents that occurred during that period.
Redact secrets, tokens, emails, and personal data before sharing logs.
Ask for counts, timelines, and evidence when using the report for incident decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not paste unbounded production logs without sampling or filtering.
Do not treat frequency alone as business impact; include service and user context.
Do not request permanent blocks or fixes without checking false positives.

faq.question: Can this skill parse JSON logs?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to recognize JSON logs and extract timestamps, levels, services, messages, and nested error details.

faq.question: Can it analyze web access logs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples for Apache-style access logs and can summarize status codes, endpoints, traffic patterns, and latency.

faq.question: Does it connect to logging platforms?
faq.answer: No direct integration is included. Provide exported logs or connect separate tools if platform access is needed.

faq.question: Is it suitable for incident response?
faq.answer: Yes. It can produce timelines, severity summaries, likely causes, and action lists from relevant log evidence.

faq.question: How should sensitive logs be handled?
faq.answer: Redact secrets, tokens, personal data, and customer identifiers before analysis whenever possible.

faq.question: Can it prove the root cause?
faq.answer: It can suggest likely causes from logs, but final confirmation usually needs metrics, traces, code review, or deployment history.
